description: Get tags and segments with their engagement and status breakdowns. Use to turn an event or interest tag into a working audience. Every tag and segment is returned in one unpaginated call, but untagged members are excluded from the tag list and surface only as a separate untaggedCount, and tag engagement rates exclude insiders while tag member counts do not.

projectId.description: Required. The opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters to scope this request to. Call GET /_api/public/v1/enterprise/projects to list the project IDs available to your API key. Omitting it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

name: sm_get_member_segments

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_get_member_segments tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

projectId.description: An opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters identifying a Space Monkey Project. Treat this value as entirely opaque; do not parse, sequentialize, or auto-generate it.

segmentType.description: The public surface deliberately renames the reserved word `type`; the shared core still returns `type`.

items.description: Engagement metrics associated with a specific tag.

avgEngagementScore.description: Mean engagement score for the tag.

items.description: Member statuses within a specific tag context.

memberCount.description: Members in the tag and status.

title: Get tags and segments
